description: Marks that the account added another reader as a friend in Resenha. Friends are readers who follow each other; this record lets the other reader's app show the follow as a friend request.

main.description: One per friend. The record key is the friend's DID, so whether someone added a reader as a friend can be found with a single getRecord. Written alongside an app.bsky.graph.follow of the same account.

subject.description: The reader added as a friend. Also the record key.
